text: Factored FormulaParser named/positional argument validation into shared TermArgs decoder covering duplicate names, unknown named args, string/identifier, numeric, integer, boolean, vector-reference, and string/identifier-reference decoding. Added parser regression coverage for duplicate, unknown, mistyped hrf_fun/data, and illegal trialwise positional args. Verification: sbt -no-colors designJVM/test designJS/test passed with 133 tests on JVM and 133 tests on JS.
